Back after a few days away, or after an update, your plan opens showing all of it, with a small card saying when it last changed. After an update the card links to What’s new, and if your plans haven’t been backed up lately, it offers a backup too. It goes as soon as you do anything else.

The second time you open FullGrown on a phone, tablet or computer, a card says once that your plans are saved there and open right where you left them, with a way to back them up to a file. It isn’t shown if you’ve backed up already, or if you’re signed in and syncing them to your account.
